clips.title: The story
paras: The Cult of the Damned is a task confronting mortal servants of the Scourge active within Tirisfal Glades. By culling Dark Neophytes and Dark Enforcers, defenders prevent the Lich King's insidious living agents from repeating the betrayals that originally shattered Lordaeron.

The Cult of the Damned represents the mortal face of the Scourge. Composed of living men and women who swore fealty to the Lich King, these cultists act where mindless dead cannot. In Tirisfal Glades, where inhabitants already contend with roaming undead and relentless zealots of the Scarlet Crusade, newly discovered cells of Dark Neophytes and Dark Enforcers signal an insidious attempt by the Scourge to re-establish a foothold.

Lordaeron was brought to ruin not merely by marching legions of the dead, but by neighbors who betrayed neighbors. The Cult of the Damned originally infiltrated villages, poisoned granaries, and orchestrated the kingdom's collapse from the shadows. Standing vigilant against fresh Cult activity in Tirisfal is essential to ensure that history does not repeat itself in the scarred lands of the north.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your aid, adventurer. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
